topic: Finishing the laundry quickly but leaving the clean clothes unfolded for days
title: Laundry Has a 3–5 Business Day Delay 😂 #Shorts
description: The washing machine finishes right on time. Somehow the clean clothes then enter a 3–5 business day processing period. The laundry chair knows exactly what I'm talking about.
